ai.title: Opening the Box Changes the Cat: LLMs Detect Chain-of-Thought Monitoring - What now?
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2610.40946v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning allows large language models (LLMs) to generate intermediate reasoning traces in natural language while solving complex tasks. These traces can support safety monitoring by exposing potentially harmful plans before actions are executed. In this work, we investigate the conditions under which LLMs infer the presence of CoT monitoring from direct and indirect environmental cues and examine how this inference affects their subsequent behavior. Our observations suggest that oversight is an interactive process: while a monitor inspects a model's reasoning, traces left by monitoring interventions can allow the model to infer that its thoughts are being observed and to adapt its behavior accordingly. We show that even subtle environmental cues, such as timing-related signals from timeouts and operation durations, can reveal the presence of monitoring and trigger models to adapt their behavior. Across repeated episodes and interaction loops, we further observe that models can form statistical estimates of the monitor's effectiveness and use these estimates to guide attempts to evade detection. These findings highlight the need to evaluate CoT-based oversight under adaptive conditions, where the monitoring process itself may influence the behavior it seeks to observe.
ai.summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning allows large language models (LLMs) to generate intermediate reasoning traces in natural language while solving complex tasks.

ai.title: CIRCE Divines LLM Task Complexity from Constraint Structure
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2610.41089v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Estimating whether a problem is too complex for a large language model (LLM) before the model attempts it can guide model routing, how to allocate test-time compute, and suggest the need for new tools to aid the agent. While existing estimators rely on the problem text, LLM-annotated task difficulty labels, or signals obtained after a model attempts to solve the problem, such as its hidden states, none explicitly leverage the constraint structure inherent in the problem: the variables to assign and how the constraints over them interact. We introduce CIRCE, which extracts a problem's structure by using a cheap LLM to construct a Constraint Intermediate Representation that deterministically compiles into the constraint graph. Across seven reasoning benchmarks (including SAT, logic, and math) and four LLMs, even a randomly initialized GNN encoder improves predictions of LLM response correctness, reducing negative log-likelihood from 0.465 to 0.423 and increasing AUROC from 0.691 to 0.727 relative to the strongest baseline for each metric.

ai.title: Counterfactual Pairwise Augmentation Improves Small Pointwise LLM Judges
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2610.41149v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic systems increasingly gate individual steps with a pointwise judge that scores a response against a criterion. Small language models are attractive for this role because they can be served and specialized efficiently. Such a judge must locate the criterion's decision boundary, but pointwise labels under-determine that boundary in fine-tuning: labeled responses to different queries differ along many dimensions at once, so they do not reveal which features decide the label. We introduce CPA (Counterfactual Pairwise Augmentation), which makes the deciding difference explicit in training. For each pointwise item, CPA synthesizes and audits a counterfactual response to the same query intended to carry the opposite label. It frames the accepted pair as a pairwise task asking which of the two responses satisfies the criterion. The judge is fine-tuned jointly on both pointwise and pairwise datasets and deployed in pointwise mode only. A second-order analysis shows when this should outperform the prevailing strategy of merging separately trained pointwise and pairwise experts: merging moves every parameter direction toward the pairwise expert by the same fraction, whereas joint training can hold the pointwise optimum wherever the pairwise loss is flat and absorb its curvature where it is sharp. This is the regime that CPA's same-source, counterfactually minimal pairwise view is designed to produce. On separate Qwen3-8B LoRA adapte
ai.summary: Agentic systems increasingly gate individual steps with a pointwise judge that scores a response against a criterion.

ai.title: Beyond Response Scoring: An AI-aware Cognitive Supervision Framework for Automated Mathematical Short Answer Grading
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2610.41215v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transformer-based language models have achieved remarkable success in automated short answer grading (ASAG). However, current methods in ASAG struggle to comprehend, reason about and evaluate complex mathematical answers involving symbols and formulas. These score-only methods fail to generalize across diverse responses and skill states associated with identical scores. Moreover, they ignore the potential upward bias introduced by generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) usage in assessing students' performance and knowledge mastery. To address these limitations, we propose AICG (AI-aware Cognitive-supervised Grading), a two-branch multi-task framework. The first branch combines RoBERTa-based regression, ordinal, and classification heads for individual-answer grading. The second branch uses an expert-designed Q-matrix to associate responses with assessed skills and jointly predicts G-DINA-derived skill mastery and learning gain. Through the shared encoder, these skill-level targets provide cognitive supervision for answer grading beyond score labels. AICG further uses a Gen-AI detector, trained through supervised contrastive pretraining followed by linear classification, to estimate assistance probabilities and convert them into reliability weights, attenuating unreliable cognitive evidence during learning assessment. We conduct experiments on 49,402 instructor-graded responses spanning 19 academic semesters. Relative to RoBERTa
ai.summary: Transformer-based language models have achieved remarkable success in automated short answer grading (ASAG).

ai.title: Beyond Public Access in LLM Pre-Training Data
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2505.00020v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Using a legally obtained dataset of 34 copyrighted O'Reilly Media books (13,962 paragraphs), we apply the DE-COP membership inference attack to test whether OpenAI models show recognition of non-public (pay-walled) content they were not licensed to train on. Our main contribution is examining non-public books, which allows us to consider potential access violations and not just training inclusion. Our results suggest that GPT-4o, OpenAI's more recent and capable model in our sample, exhibits patterns consistent with recognition of non-public books, with an AUROC score of 0.82 (95% bootstrapped CI: 0.60-0.96) -- where above 50% is better than random chance. GPT-3.5 Turbo (trained two years prior) and the smaller GPT-4o Mini both score near chance recognition on non-public data (0.54 and 0.56, respectively). Results are robust to independent paraphrasers (Gemma and Qwen) and leave-one-book-out sensitivity analyses. We also test both GPT-4o and GPT-4o mini, with the same October 2023 training cutoff date, to ensure the model is not simply identifying language shifts over time. These findings support disclosure requirements for pre-training data provenance and formal licensing markets for training content. Results remain preliminary given the small book sample, possible contamination of post-cutoff controls, and differences across models in size, architecture, and training composition.

ai.title: VerifyMAS: Hypothesis Verification for Failure Attribution in LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2605.17467v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large language model-driven multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) excel at complex tasks, yet unreliable agents remain a key bottleneck to system-level reliability. Automatic failure attribution is therefore critical, but existing approaches, such as direct prediction of agent-error pairs and agent-first failure attribution, rely on local logs of agents and miss global failures that only manifest over full interaction trajectories, such as cross-step inconsistencies and inter-agent coordination errors. Moreover, directly predicting failures induces a large combinatorial search space, hindering fine-grained attribution. To address these challenges, we propose VerifyMAS, a hypothesis verification framework for agent failure attribution. Instead of directly predicting faulty agents and error types, VerifyMAS formulates and verifies failure hypotheses against full trajectories. This verification-based approach decomposes attribution into trajectory-level error validation and fine-grained agent localization, providing an error-first attribution approach that captures global failure patterns while substantially reducing the search space. We further introduce a hypothesis-based data construction strategy grounded in a structured error taxonomy and fine-tune a specialized LLM verifier model for trajectory-level failure verification and agent attribution. ai.summary: Large language model-driven multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) excel at complex tasks, yet unreliable agents remain a key bottleneck to system-level reliability.

trade.title: 假交友、真詐財！冒用海關人員名義要求匯款是詐騙，請民眾提高警覺
trade.source_name: 財政部關務署 新聞
trade.via: 財政部關務署 新聞
trade.raw_summary: 財政部關務署近日接獲民眾反映，疑有不肖人士透過通訊軟體LINE，以網路交友、寄送包裹等話術取得民眾信任，並冒用海關人員名義，要求民眾匯款至指定帳戶。關務署鄭重澄清，海關關員絕不會透過私人通訊軟體要求民眾匯款或私下處理包裹或進出口貨物，呼籲民眾提高警覺，以免受騙。 關務署強調，海關辦理進出口貨物通關及稅費徵收，均依相關法令及正式行政程序辦理，不會由首長或關員透過私人通訊軟體，要求民眾匯款至指定私人帳戶，也不會以個人身分承諾協助寄送、保管、放行包裹或進出口貨物。相關稅費及罰鍰均應透過合法繳納管道入帳國庫，民眾切勿依不明人士指示匯款。 關務署再次提醒，民眾如遇網路交友對象以寄送包裹、禮物或貴重物品為由，要求支付通關費、保險費或其他費用，應審慎查證，切勿輕信對方提供的海關人員姓名、職稱或通訊軟體帳號。如有疑義，可至關務署官方網站（https://web.customs.gov.tw）查詢，或撥打關務署電話（02）2550-5500及165反詐騙諮詢專線確認，共同防範詐騙，保障自身財產安全。 新聞稿聯絡人：劉科長 聯絡電話：（02）25505500分機2102

trade.title: 海關籲請正確申報統計用數量，提升貿易統計品質
trade.raw_summary: 財政部關務署表示，高品質的海關進出口貿易統計資料，除金額之正確性外，統一的計量單位亦不容忽視。依聯合國國際商品貿易統計手冊建議，同一稅則六碼下貨品應盡量使用相同之數量單位，據此，關務署依各貨品不同屬性，訂定一致性之統計用數量單位，共17種供報關使用，俾利國際規範接軌及提高資料準確度。 關務署指出，進口報單中數量欄位有二種：一為第41欄「數量（單位）」，係計價用數量，請依發票所載交易數量填列；二為第42欄「數量（統計用）」，請依「中華民國海關進口稅則輸出入貨品分類表合訂本」單位欄內所載單位換算後填列，以取得具比較性的數量資料。 關務署舉例說明，部分紡織品之統計用單位為MTK（平方公尺），惟常見之計價單位為碼或英吋，申報時若未將長、寬個別換算為公尺即直接相乘，就會產生誤報情形。以下為常見換算範例，提醒業者注意： 一、碼數換算（1碼=0.9144公尺）：「長1,214碼、寬1.5公尺」之尼龍胚布，應先將長度（碼）轉換為公尺再乘寬，正確計算為 (1,214 × 0.9144) × 1.5 ≒ 1,665.12平方公尺。 二、英吋換算（1英吋=0.0254公尺）：「長300公尺、寬47英吋」之沙發布，應先將寬度（英吋）轉換為公尺，正確算法為 300 × (47 × 0.0254) ≒ 358平方公尺。 關務署籲請業者應正確申報統計用數量，以提升我國貿易統計資料之正確性，該署亦彙整申報統計用數量單位應注意事項及常見錯誤案例，置於海關進出口統計查詢網＞貿易統計＞其他參考資訊＞統計宣導事項（https://portal.sw.nat.gov.tw/APGA/GA17_DEC）＞ 4.統計用數量單位，歡迎民眾及業者多加利用。 新聞稿聯絡人：劉科長 聯絡電話：（02）25505500分機2806

trade.title: 第28屆臺史經技合作會議聚焦多元合作，深化經貿夥伴關係
trade.source_name: 經濟部國際貿易署 新聞
trade.via: 經濟部國際貿易署 新聞
trade.raw_summary: 經濟部龔明鑫部長與史瓦帝尼經濟企畫暨發展部吉納部長(Thambo Gina)於今(28)日共同主持第28屆臺史經技合作會議，雙方就協助史商拓銷及採購、婦女創業、建立全民健保制度，以及增進雙方在觀光、資安等領域之合作進行交流。 經濟部龔部長表示，史瓦帝尼是我國在非洲最重要的友邦，雙邊經貿關係平穩，本(2026)年1月至9月我自史國進口金額較2025年同期顯著成長逾210.74%，顯見臺史貿易往來日益密切，經貿關係穩定發展。隨著雙邊經貿持續成長，臺灣已成為史國在亞洲重要貿易夥伴，如經濟部近年持續協助史瓦帝尼業者來臺參加國際展會，增加該國產品國際曝光度及市場商機，另協助史國建置Buy Eswatini手機購物APP，拓展當地業者數位行銷通路，提升產品銷售機會。本年6月台北國際食品展，經濟部特為史國舉辦調酒秀，將該國蘭姆酒搭配我國檸檬，結合兩國特色產品，深化彼此情誼，共同拓展潛在商機。 史方吉納部長則表示，在面臨地緣政治緊張之際，經濟韌性日益重要，史方感謝我政府長期的支持與協助，與史國共同推動各項合作計畫，臺史經技合作會議對強化雙方經貿夥伴關係扮演重要角色，很高興藉此會議平臺拉近彼此的距離，盼雙方擴大目前合作範疇，持續深化交流，以利提升人民生活福祉並續創合作契機。 經濟部指出，臺灣與史瓦帝尼的夥伴關係不僅在貿易連結，更在其他領域富有合作潛力，如我方近年成功促成觀光團赴史旅遊，未來將持續推動臺史觀光合作，並邀請史方率團來臺參與台北國際旅展，吸引更多國人赴史觀光；另外，我方與史國分享推動全民健保相關經驗，樂願協助史國逐步打造人民可平等就醫之環境，未來亦有助我醫療產品拓展非洲市場，顯示雙方正逐漸邁向更全面多元的夥伴關係。 臺史經貿關係穩定發展，自雙方於2018年簽署經濟合作協定(ECA)以來，雙邊貿易持續成長。2025年臺灣為史國第10大進口國，2026年1月至9月我自史國進口金額較2025年同期顯著成長逾210%，展現雙邊經貿合作的豐碩成果。我政府將賡續推動各項經貿交流與合作，史國亦持續在相關國際場域為我發聲，雙方攜手深化夥伴關係，共創互利雙贏局面。 貿易署發言人：胡副署長 聯絡電話：02-2397-7109、02-2397-7178、0966-525-106 業務聯絡人：雙邊貿易二組謝組長 聯絡電話：02-2397-7401

world.title: 中國灰色地帶施壓日本 日學者籲攜手國際強化嚇阻
world.raw_summary: （中央社記者劉郁葶布拉格2日專電）日本國際政治學者東野篤子指出，中國對日本的灰色地帶施壓已擴及外交、經濟與文化等領域，這類行動雖未直接跨越武裝衝突門檻，卻可能逐步改變區域現狀、侵蝕國際秩序。她表示，日本應透過有效管轄、國際合作，強化拒止嚇阻能力，讓施壓者理解「成功改變現狀的可能性很低」。

world.title: 美伊有望談出和平？國際油價齊跌逾6% 美油跌破100美元
world.raw_summary: 美伊釋出外交解決訊號，國際油價周一早盤重挫，兩大原油期貨跌幅均逾6%。 截至美東8:55，布蘭特原油跌6.07%至106.54美元，WTI跌6.2%至97.65美元，WTI跌破每桶100美元。 美方仍為11月3日期中選舉後可能軍事行動做準備，伊朗警告若受威脅將立即有力反擊。

world.title: 美国拟为"影子舰队"松绑？专家警告莫削弱对俄制裁
world.url: https://www.dw.com/zh/美国拟为-影子舰队-松绑？专家警告莫削弱对俄制裁/a-79806146?maca=chi-rss-chi-all-1127-rdf
world.raw_summary: 俄罗斯借助由老旧油轮组成的"影子舰队"规避西方制裁。据报道，特朗普政府正考虑解除部分影子舰队油轮的制裁，以缓解创纪录的运费。专家警告，此举将削弱对俄制裁、帮助莫斯科获得收入，并使美欧在战略上分道扬镳。欧盟虽握有航运和保险等工具，但若没有美国支持，执法将更加艰难。
